cohort: The study involved 210 women from St. Joseph Hospital, Koforidua, whose medical records were reviewed.
finding: Persistent postpartum preeclampsia had a prevalence of 15.2%, and cesarean section delivery and chronic hypertension were significantly associated with increased odds of this condition.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was identified as an independent predictor, significantly increasing the odds of persistent postpartum preeclampsia.
